subject: StateU DPA: redline comments and evidence logistics
messages:
From: Emma Owen <emma.owen@stateu.edu>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, procurement@stateu.edu
Cc: legal@stateu.edu
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: StateU DPA / vendor evidence request

Irene,

Thanks for taking this — State University of Newell is moving quickly on the DPA for the upcoming learning analytics pilot. Attached is our standard DPA template (StateU_DPA_Template.docx). Two asks to start: 

1) Please return your redlines to our template; we need to confirm any non-standard clauses (notably data residency, subprocessor approval, and audit access).
2) Provide evidence for your security posture: SOC 2 attestation (redacted fine), SIG/CAIQ answers, and a short summary of logging/retention for student records.

Can you confirm by COB Monday Nov 22 whether you can provide the requested artifacts and a point of contact for security incidents? If you foresee issues with the DPA terms, flag them in your redline and we will route to legal.

Attachment: StateU_DPA_Template.docx

Best,
Emma Owen
Procurement Manager | State University of Newell
emma.owen@stateu.edu
procurement@stateu.edu

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Emma Owen <emma.owen@stateu.edu>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: StateU DPA / vendor evidence request

Emma — thanks, we can take this on. A few quick notes and questions up front so we assemble the correct artifacts: 

- We will return a redline to your DPA (see attached StateU_DPA_Redlines_20261118.docx). The redline includes an alternative data-subject notification timeline and clarifies audit access procedures.
- Attached: SOC2_Attestation_Redacted.pdf (current year) and a SIG/CAIQ index we typically provide.

Clarifying questions for your team so we tailor evidence:
1) Does StateU require execution of EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) in addition to the DPA for vendor data transfers?
2) Is a full DPIA required for the pilot (the dataset will include student identifiers + grades)? If so, please share the DPIA scope or the questionnaire fields you expect us to address.
3) What is the specific minimum retention period for logs/audit trails your reviewers will accept (we have standard 18/24/36 month profiles)?
Also, could you confirm whether the counterparty on the DPA will be "State University of Newell" (university legal entity) or the Board? That affects signature routing.
Attachments: StateU_DPA_Redlines_20261118.docx; SOC2_Attestation_Redacted.pdf
If it helps, Rishi (CC'd on later messages) can provide a technical call to walk through CAIQ mappings.

Thanks — I will prioritize this and aim to get the redline and evidence links to you before the 22nd.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Manager, Compliance & Trust
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

From: Emma Owen <emma.owen@stateu.edu>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: StateU DPA / vendor evidence request
Thanks, Irene — quick answers inline below.
> 1) SCCs required?
Yes. Because some researchers will access data from EU-based collaborators, we need SCCs for cross-border transfers and a short statement of where data may be processed.
> 2) DPIA required?
The project will trigger a DPIA. We will share the DPIA template but for now the scope is student records + academic performance; assume moderate sensitivity.
> 3) Log retention minimum?
24 months for audit logs related to student records.
Counterparty: please list the university legal entity as State University of Newell (Board signs later if required).
We have also attached a short SCCs checklist and our vendor evidence intake spreadsheet for SIG/CAIQ items. Procurement would like final artifacts delivered into our vendor portal: https://procure.stateu.edu/vendors/upload (we will also accept shared Drive links until DocuSign flow is ready).
Attachment: StateU_SCCs_Checklist.xlsx
Can you confirm whether you can deliver a CAIQ-style spreadsheet mapping and whether SOC 2 + CAIQ will be acceptable for initial approval?
Best,
Emma
Procurement Manager
State University of Newell
procurement@stateu.edu

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Emma Owen <emma.owen@stateu.edu>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 13:55:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: StateU DPA / vendor evidence request — technical follow-up
Emma / Irene — Rishi here, Director of Security & Privacy at Redwood. Confirming the items we will provide and proposed handling: 
1) SOC 2: we are attaching the redacted attestation (see SOC2_Attestation_Redacted.pdf already shared). That should be sufficient for initial review. For CAI mapping, we will provide a CAIQ-style spreadsheet that maps our controls to the SIG/CIS questions. See attached SIG-Overview-2026.xlsx and a shared Drive folder with the full mapping: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDEfGHIjkLmnoPqRstUV
2) SCCs: we can accept the SCCs and propose minimal, non-substantive redlines limited to subprocessors and liability caps. If you need us to sign your SCCs as a processor, that is acceptable; please confirm the specific SCC template/version.
3) DPIA: we will need the DPIA template so we can populate our inputs (processing description, retention, mitigation). Once received, we can return a completed vendor section within 3 business days.
4) Logging & retention: standard practice — 24 months for security/audit logs for student-data-related requests. We log requestor identity, timestamp, IP, and action; logs are immutable and maintained in an access-controlled archive. If you have a specific field list required for the DPIA, send it and we'll map.
5) Incident contact: security-ops@redwood.com, +1 (415) 555-0123 (24/7 pager). We will accept routine notifications to ciso@stateu.edu and a legal notice to legal@stateu.edu.
6) Evidence delivery: acceptable to share a Drive link into your intake portal for now; DocuSign for the DPA is fine for signature routing.
Attachments: SIG-Overview-2026.xlsx
If StateU would like a short (30-minute) walkthrough of the CAIQ mapping, I can host a call tomorrow morning PT.
Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Security & Privacy
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Emma Owen <emma.owen@stateu.edu>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: StateU DPA / vendor evidence request — scheduling
Team — appreciate the fast responses. Quick summary and next steps from procurement: 
- SOC 2 attestation + CAIQ-style spreadsheet are acceptable for initial security review.
- StateU requires SCCs for EU transfers; please include a short statement of processing locations in the CAIQ mapping.
- DPIA: we will send the DPIA template this afternoon; please populate the vendor section (3 business days preferred).

Can we book a 30-minute call Thursday Nov 23 at 10:00 AM ET to walk through the CAIQ mapping and discuss SCC wording? If that works, procurement will open a vendor portal intake and I will upload the DPA template and our SCC checklist. We will also expect the redline and Drive link for evidence before COB Monday Nov 22 as discussed.
Thanks again — talk soon.

Best,
Emma Owen
Procurement Manager
State University of Newell
procurement@stateu.edu
